mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces equity discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a rising housing starts index (HOUST) above 2000 thousand units signals strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, HOUST above 2000 thousand units fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth over 6 months fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 199.0 for two consecutive months, it signals accelerating inflation, which prompts central bank tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL has been above 199.0 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In low-unemployment regimes, PAYEMS above 135,000 thousand fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a monetary tightening that is also causing economic slowdown, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of FEDFUNDS rising and INDPRO falling fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.
